note.invalidation: the port authority reopens the loading channel
note.summary: A fictional export terminal suspends loading after a channel obstruction. Supply uncertainty supports crude while authorities assess access.
key_points: The harbour authority schedules an inspection before deciding whether to resume traffic.
A second publisher reports tankers waiting outside the terminal.

risks.note: The obstruction prevents loading and leaves restart timing unresolved.
A rapid reopening could reverse the supply-risk premium.
